system: An experiment's report page: a tested kernel scores committed token counts (measured with Anthropic's count_tokens endpoint by a local script) and renders the findings. The page runs no model and collects nothing.

aiAct.why: No AI system (Art 3(1)): the build runs no model that infers its outputs, so the AI Act places no duty on it.

gdpr.why: No personal data is processed, so no GDPR / UK GDPR duty arises from the build.
